why: The JSPE-S is a named, reusable self-report assessment instrument rather than an instructional element.
name: Jefferson Scale of Empathy – Student Version (JSPE-S)
product_description: A 20-item, 7-point Likert self-report instrument for measuring medical students' empathic orientation toward patients, developed by the Jefferson medical education research group.

why: The JSE-HPS is a named, licensed psychometric assessment instrument rather than a general instructional element.
name: Jefferson Scale of Empathy, Healthcare Professions Student version (JSE-HPS)
product_description: The JSE-HPS is a 20-item Likert-scale self-report assessment developed by the Jefferson Scale of Empathy authors for measuring cognitive empathy among healthcare professions students.
